title: Going Up the Hill
description: A sunny hilltop walk turns into a kite-flying adventure

fields.prompt: Pick a part of the body.

template:
On a sunny day, {name1} and {name2} walked up the hill to fly their kite. They packed {container.article} {container} of {substance} for their big adventure.

At the top, the wind whooshed through the grass. Their kite danced high in the sky, then got caught on a friendly old sign. Its tail was tangled with {thing.plural}, and the kite looked very {adjective}.

The friends worked together to reach the kite. {name1} held the {container}, while {name2} carefully tugged the string. A loud {noise} came from the bushes. It was only a little {animal}, cheering them on!

A gust of wind gave the kite a lift, and it floated free. The string looped around {name1.possessive} {bodyPart}, but {name1.Pronoun} gently untangled it. Everyone was safe, and the {animal} did a happy dance.

They sat under a shady tree and shared their {substance}. Before heading home, {name1} and {name2} decided to {verb} all the way down the hill. The {animal} danced as their kite soared above them. They waved goodbye and started planning their next adventure.
